title: Market Surf Report

conditions.headline: Split swell: Microsoft rides, Alphabet wipes out
conditions.summary: Nasdaq futures are down about 1% after Alphabet's sales miss, while Dow and small-cap futures rise. GDP, PCE inflation and the ECB decision land this morning.

sections.title: Futures & Overnight
items: Early quotes: S&P 500 futures -0.2%, Nasdaq-100 futures -1.0%, Dow futures +0.5%, Russell 2000 futures +0.6%.
The 10-year Treasury yield is near 5.05%, up about 5 basis points.
WTI crude is down about 1.1%, near $101.6; gold is slightly lower, near $4,044.
Bitcoin is down about 1.8%, near $79,900; the VIX is near 17.2.
Asia was mixed: the Nikkei rose about 1% while Korea's Kospi fell about 1% and Shanghai slipped.
Europe: the STOXX 600 is about flat ahead of the ECB; Shell +2.6% and Airbus +3.2% on results.

sections.title: Macro & Economic Calendar
items: The Fed held rates at 3.75%–4% on Wednesday in a 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack wanted a hike.
CME FedWatch shows over an 80% chance of a December rate hike.
7:30 AM CT: Q3 GDP (consensus +3.2% annualized), September PCE (headline +0.5% m/m, core +0.3% m/m, core +3.1% y/y) and jobless claims (about 199,000).
8:15 AM CT: ECB rate decision, expected to hold at 2.5%; press conference follows.

sections.title: Earnings
items: Microsoft beat on revenue and earnings, helped by Azure; shares up about 3.6% pre-market.
Alphabet missed on sales and showed negative free cash flow from AI spending; shares down about 10% pre-market.
ServiceNow fell about 18% on a small earnings miss; Fortinet fell about 25% after its report.
Carvana rose about 8% on record unit sales; Chipotle rose about 7% as traffic held up.
Before the open today: Eli Lilly, Mastercard, Merck, Caterpillar, Bristol Myers Squibb, Linde, Altria.
After the close today: Amazon, Intel, Starbucks, Coinbase, Sandisk, Gilead, Stryker, Mondelez.

sections.title: Stocks in the News
items: FTNT (Fortinet): -25% — sharp drop after its quarterly report.
NOW (ServiceNow): -18% — slight earnings miss.
GOOGL (Alphabet): -10% — sales miss and heavy AI spending.
MRVL (Marvell Technology): -10% — chip selloff on AI-spending jitters.
CVNA (Carvana): +8% — record car sales.
CMG (Chipotle): +7% — restaurant traffic held up.
MSFT (Microsoft): +3.6% — earnings and cloud beat.
MU (Micron): -3% — chipmakers lower in sympathy.

sections.title: Business News
items: GE Vernova agreed to buy grid-equipment maker Trench Group from Triton for $9 billion and raised its revenue outlook again.
An investor group including Nelson Peltz offered $1.4 billion to take Wendy's private.
MGM Resorts says acquisition talks with People Inc. have ended.
Shell posted its biggest quarterly profit since 2022 and increased its buyback.
Law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges plans to wind down after a wave of partner departures.

sections.title: What to Watch Today
items: 7:30 AM CT: GDP and PCE inflation — a hot core reading would add to December hike bets with the 10-year near 5%.
8:15 AM CT: ECB decision, then Lagarde's comments on French bonds.
After the close: Amazon and Intel results test the AI trade after Alphabet's slide.

script: Cowabunga! This is Surf Daddy, your local Kahuna, live from Surfside USA to all you Trade Wind surfers from the Gulf Coast to the North Shore. It's Thursday, October twenty-ninth, twenty twenty-six, and this is your Market Surf Report. Gus the wonder dog is on his beach towel, ready for dawn patrol. Give the crew a big hello, Gus! Conditions are fair, with a split swell from Big Tech earnings. Early quotes show S and P five hundred futures down about two tenths of a percent, and Nasdaq one hundred futures down about one percent. Dow futures are up about half a percent, and Russell two thousand futures are up about six tenths of a percent. The ten year Treasury yield is near five point zero five percent. Crude oil is down about one percent, near one hundred and one dollars. Bitcoin is down almost two percent, near eighty thousand dollars. Tokyo gained overnight, Korea slipped, and Europe is flat. Now, wind and weather. The Fed held rates steady yesterday, but two officials voted for a hike. Futures traders now see better than an eighty percent chance of a December hike. At seven thirty A M Central we get third quarter G D P, expected near three point two percent. We also get September P C E inflation and jobless claims. The European Central Bank decides at eight fifteen. On the tide chart, Microsoft beat on earnings and cloud growth, and the stock is up about three and a half percent before the bell. Now that is a Kahuna catching a clean wave. That calls for a treat, Gus! Here you go, buddy! Alphabet wiped out, down about ten percent after a sales miss and heavy A I spending. ServiceNow and Fortinet took gnarly spills too. Carvana and Chipotle are hanging ten. After the close, Amazon, Intel, Starbucks and Coinbase report. In the lineup, chip stocks are soft,, with Marvell down near ten percent. Beach talk. G E Vernova plans to buy grid equipment maker Trench Group for nine billion dollars. An investor group led by Nelson Peltz offered one point four billion dollars for Wendy's. Sets to watch: the seven thirty data, the European Central Bank, and Amazon and Intel tonight. Stay stoked, but don't be a kook chasing the first set. Want my read on a wave of your own? This is Surf Daddy and Gus the wonder dog saying, if in doubt, paddle out!
